# Liveteachcreate

> Premier Digital Marketing, E-Commerce Marketplace Account Management, SEO, and Web Development Agency based in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India.

## About Us
Liveteachcreate offers end-to-end digital growth services for e-commerce brands, sellers, and local businesses. We specialize in marketplace onboarding and account management across leading platforms including Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, and Zepto.

## Core Services
- **E-Commerce Account Management**: Full cataloging, listing optimization, account setup, and sales growth on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, and Quick Commerce (Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto).
- **PPC Advertising Management**: Sponsored Ads management for Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Local SEO, technical SEO, e-commerce product SEO, and organic ranking growth.
- **Web Development**: Custom modern websites, web applications, and digital portals.
- **Digital Growth Consulting**: Business account audits, catalog creation, and listing error resolution.
